name: Blood Steve
description: Blood Steve stalks your world: 666 HP, Darkness on every hit and a 128-block hunting range. Torches die as he passes and a heartbeat warns you when he is close. Run too far and he finds you again.
author: BetterSkills

name: Zombie Apocalypse
description: Five new zombie types: fast Runners, Toxic zombies that burst into poison clouds, huge Brutes, Screamers that call the horde and shambling Walkers. Every third night a Blood Moon rises and the waves keep coming.
author: BetterSkills

name: Creepypasta Shader
description: A horror atmosphere pack: thick fog in every biome, murky water and a blood-red moon with a face. With Vibrant Visuals turned on you also get a dark red sky and muted colours.
author: BetterSkills

name: Hospital's Echo: The Abandoned Wards
description: Use the Abandoned Wards Map to raise a ruined hospital. The doors slam shut behind you: find 5 relics while the Ghost Nurse hunts the corridors and the lights fail one by one, then escape through the back door.
author: BetterSkills

name: Nightmare Squad
description: 16 original horror skins: Plague Doctor, Hollow Wraith, Carnival Clown, Scarecrow, Ghost Bride, Porcelain Doll, Static Head, Night Nurse and more. Pick yours in the Dressing Room.
author: BetterSkills

name: The Dead Woods
description: Use the Cursed Compass to enter a fenced dead forest at midnight. Collect 8 bags of cash while the Watcher, a giant floating eye, hunts you. When it opens, freeze: move and it hurts you and comes closer.
author: BetterSkills

name: Out of the Darkness
description: Something waits in the mines. Stay in the dark without a light and your fear grows until the Hollow One comes for you. Mine Dread Ore for a Dread Pickaxe, a Dread Blade and the Fear Tonic.
author: BetterSkills
